noellesroles.ending.quote.trial: All judgments that should be done are done, before the terminal arrives.
noellesroles.ending.quote.journey: Rolling over wailing ghosts and unfinished grudges, the cold wheels stop turning.
noellesroles.ending.quote.blood: The sins aboard will be buried forever beneath the blizzard.
noellesroles.ending.quote.naku: This time the body never returned to the berth — and after that, there was no one at all.
noellesroles.ending.quote.thief: 先是将头牢牢缠住紧粘不放 继而将头盖骨快速溶化
noellesroles.ending.quote.novelist: 那浸染着错号颜色的湿润的眼 想要在磨亮的剪刀上倒映出来
noellesroles.ending.quote.cult: Just like what you gave me without knowing, if I could become someone's heart too.
noellesroles.epilogue.cult.title: Cult Epilogue
noellesroles.epilogue.cult.line: Lamenting “such a world” - can it become a reason for someone to live?
noellesroles.ending.quote.majo: No matter how many times, no matter whose life it is, let me exist as myself.
noellesroles.ending.quote.lovers: 若要由我来谈论爱的话 在那双眼中映出的又是何等景象
noellesroles.ending.quote.archenemy: 呼唤了春天的暴风雨 我哭了起来 心已经受了伤
noellesroles.epilogue.majo.title: Witch's Epilogue
noellesroles.epilogue.survival.title: Survival Epilogue
noellesroles.epilogue.survival.line: A bullet flies - emptiness at last, borne to bone and ash.
noellesroles.epilogue.kidnapper.title: Gluttony Epilogue
noellesroles.epilogue.kidnapper.line: A face assembled from scavenged shards, pupils stirring dreams into murk with spoken light.
noellesroles.epilogue.gardener.title: Gardener's Epilogue
noellesroles.epilogue.gardener.line: Trampling a single flower into rot, gripping its bloom as if to snap it
noellesroles.ending.quote.kidnapper: Filling the lungs with cold air, filling the organs with calm life.
noellesroles.ending.quote.gardener: Painting again the memories that could never be delivered, weeping aloud with them.
noellesroles.ending.quote.arsonist: One spark, and the whole train will speak for me.
noellesroles.epilogue.majo.line: Even if I say it is my life, even if I say it is whose life, may it be judged fairly.

noellesroles.special.heretic.killer_win: 简单的事情都没法理解 我究竟是何物

Right click on food/drink trays to use
Clears all poison applied to trays
Protects anyone who drinks a defensed drink one extra hit of life.
Invisible to other players.

Right click on food/drink trays to use
Creates fakes poison, making the consumer of the poisoned item
think they are poisoned, but have no physical effect.
